title: Through The Force Things You Will See
caption: Through The Force Things You Will See (V)
game_text: If you are about to recirculate at the end of your turn, and you have fewer cards in Used Pile than Force Pile, place your Used Pile under your Force Pile instead. OR Place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Force Pile.
lore: One training exercise for a Jedi’s apprentice is to invert one’s view to see things from a different perspective. “The future, the past. Old friends long gone.”
